newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Philippine Senate cuts 1997 budget proposal.
newsitem.headline: Philippine Senate cuts 1997 budget proposal.

text.p: The Philippine Senate has cut 1997 budget expenditure proposals by about 82.6 billion pesos and approved a figure of 392.35 billion pesos, Senate Finance Committee Chairman Ernesto Herrera said on Tuesday.
The House of Representatives last month approved a budget of 474.95 billion pesos.
Herrera said the Senate decided at a late night sitting on Monday to remove debt service payments from the budget "since it was anyway automatically appropriated".
Other cuts included counterpart funding to a foreign-assisted telephone project, the National Telephone Programme, Herrera said in a statement.

"By not including the debt service fund in the new appropriations, we are avoiding the temptation for the legislators to use some of the amount to fund congressional initiatives as had been done in the past," Herrera said.
The Senate and the House will reconclie their versions of the 1997 budget through a bicameral committee.
Congress is set to go on a Christmas break on Friday.
